scenarios.title: Only an untapped permanent can be tapped
decisions: A casts Twiddle targeting Compassionate Healer, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Twiddle resolves and A chooses to tap.
If Compassionate Healer's trigger fires, it resolves and A keeps the scryed card on top.

variants.label: untapped
variants.expected: Compassionate Healer becomes tapped and its trigger fires: A gains 1 life (21) and scries 1, keeping Forest on top.

variants.label: already-tapped
variants.expected: Twiddle resolves and tapping does nothing: Compassionate Healer stays tapped, it does not become tapped again, its trigger does not fire and A's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's TapOrUntap prompt may not offer tap for an already tapped permanent; force the choice if so.

scenarios.title: Only a tapped permanent can be untapped
decisions: A casts Twiddle targeting Servant of Tymaret, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Twiddle resolves and A chooses to untap.
If Servant of Tymaret's trigger fires, it resolves.

variants.label: tapped
variants.expected: Servant of Tymaret becomes untapped and its inspired trigger fires: B loses 1 life (19) and A gains 1 life (21).

variants.label: already-untapped
variants.expected: Twiddle resolves and untapping does nothing: Servant of Tymaret stays untapped, its trigger does not fire and life totals stay 20 and 20.
